title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Cut: 81.0% on 21 attempts; ISO: 58.8% on 17 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 48.1% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers. ISO: keep a gap, show help at the level of the ball and make him score over a crowd.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 48.1% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Post-Up: 6 TO in 27 uses (22.2% vs 8.1% across all actions); Transition: 9 TO in 89 uses (10.1% vs 8.1% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
